title: Alumnae Page
body:
Alumnae Page

As former students of Bnos Yisroel, we recognize the tremendous efforts our teachers put into ensuring our success, as they strove to meet our needs both in and out of the classroom. Supporting professional development is a way for us to give back to our teachers, while helping the current and future students of Bnos Yisroel. With our support, the school will have the ability to offer the teachers opportunities to learn and be inspired through new and innovative materials, workshops, courses and conventions. Our support of the Bnos Yisroel professional development program will make a difference now and forever.

Please join us in giving back!

Sincerely,

The Alumnae Committee
